datasets.name: Updated Nearby Galaxy Catalog (UNGC)
datasets.organization: Karachentsev, Makarov & Kaisina (SAO RAS) via CDS VizieR
datasets.purpose: Local-volume galaxy impostors (~11 Mpc) with positions, distances, sizes, inclinations, velocities
datasets.license: CDS VizieR catalogue data: free scientific use with acknowledgement of the original paper and CDS.
datasets.citation: Karachentsev, Makarov & Kaisina 2013, AJ 145, 101; data via VizieR (Ochsenbein et al. 2000, A&AS 143, 23).
datasets.cachePolicy: versioned offline snapshot; optional online refresh
datasets.limitations: Distances have heterogeneous methods (TRGB, Cepheids, SBF, Tully-Fisher, velocity) and no per-object error in this table; absMagB derived from apparent B without extinction correction; logMstar assumes M/L_K=0.6 (illustrative); no group membership (tidalIndex only).

datasets.name: Curated famous galaxies
datasets.purpose: Orientation, size and distance for the rich procedural reconstructions
datasets.mechanism: hand-entered literature values; UNGC positions where available
datasets.license: Facts from published papers, cited per row; compilation CC0.
datasets.citation: See distRef / orientationRef / bhRef per row (McConnachie 2012; Karachentsev+2013; Pietrzynski+2019; EHT 2019; others).
datasets.limitations: Inclination/PA are single literature values (mixed methods); null where not reliably known. Not re-verified against the original papers in this run beyond recall - treat as best-effort.

datasets.name: Groups, clusters, superclusters and voids
datasets.purpose: Labels for large-scale structure at multiple scales
datasets.license: Facts from published papers, cited per row; compilation CC0.
datasets.citation: See refs per row (Abell 1958; Tully+2014; Kraan-Korteweg+1996; Geller & Huchra 1989; Gott+2005; ...)
datasets.limitations: Centres of voids, superclusters and walls are approximate (positionQuality="approximate"); membership counts are indicative. Distances from redshift use the Planck18 comoving distance.

datasets.name: 2MASS Redshift Survey (2MRS)
datasets.organization: Huchra et al. (CfA/2MASS) via CDS VizieR
datasets.mechanism: VizieR ASU TSV (J/ApJS/199/26/table3) -> comoving Cartesian Float32
datasets.license: CDS VizieR catalogue data: free scientific use with acknowledgement of the original paper and CDS.
datasets.citation: Huchra et al. 2012, ApJS 199, 26; Skrutskie et al. 2006 (2MASS); data via VizieR.
datasets.cachePolicy: versioned offline snapshot; optional online refresh
datasets.fallback: use the deep DESI sample only
datasets.limitations: Zone of Avoidance (|b|<5 deg) empty; redshift-space distortions (fingers of God); distances from CMB-frame redshift, unreliable below z~0.003 (peculiar velocities); magnitude-limited (Ks<=11.75).

datasets.name: DESI DR1 BGS Bright clustering catalogue (sampled)
datasets.mechanism: HTTP download of LSS clustering .dat FITS (NGC+SGC) -> comoving Cartesian Float32, random subsample
datasets.license: DESI DR1 public data: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0) per the DESI DR1 data-release terms (https://data.desi.lbl.gov/doc/acknowledgments/); acknowledge DESI as requested.
datasets.citation: DESI Collaboration et al. 2026, AJ 171, 285 (Data Release 1 of DESI); Ross et al. 2025, JCAP 01, 125. This research used data obtained with the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI); see https://data.desi.lbl.gov/doc/acknowledgments/.
datasets.rateLimits: not documented (4 files downloaded, SHA-256 verified)
datasets.limitations: Partial sky (two caps -> wedges); clustering weights/completeness not applied; random subsample 45.5%; redshift-space distortions; BGS colour field is g-r AB (see header).

datasets.name: DESI DR1 LRG clustering catalogue (sampled)
datasets.purpose: Deeper cosmic-web layer (0.4<z<1.1 luminous red galaxies)
datasets.mechanism: HTTP download of LSS clustering .dat FITS (NGC+SGC) -> comoving Cartesian Float32, random subsample
datasets.license: DESI DR1 public data: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0) per the DESI DR1 data-release terms (https://data.desi.lbl.gov/doc/acknowledgments/); acknowledge DESI as requested.
datasets.citation: DESI Collaboration et al. 2026, AJ 171, 285 (Data Release 1 of DESI); Ross et al. 2025, JCAP 01, 125. This research used data obtained with the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI); see https://data.desi.lbl.gov/doc/acknowledgments/.
datasets.limitations: Partial sky; weights not applied; random subsample 18.7%.
